## What and why / 变更与原因

Link the related issue and summarize the user-visible change.

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behavior change, or explained why none are needed.
- [ ] I listed commands and results, including checks that still require a live service or model.
- [ ] I documented any migration, API, configuration, or user workflow changes.
- [ ] I checked that the diff contains no secrets, personal evidence, or user exports.

## Rollout / 发布

List any deployment order, follow-up, or rollback constraints.
